fartWithYourFriendsBeginnerGuide.title: Fart With Your Friends Beginner Guide
fartWithYourFriendsBeginnerGuide.subtitle: Learn the basic flow from entering the game to completing your first river run.
fartWithYourFriendsBeginnerGuide.intro: Fart With Your Friends centers on guiding a raft through a river while working with other players. Start with the objective, get a feel for raft movement, and then coordinate with teammates around obstacles.

steps.title: Enter the Game
steps.description: Join Fart With Your Friends through its Roblox game page and wait for the game area to load.
steps.tip: Scan the available modes before starting your first run.

steps.title: Choose a River Activity
steps.description: Select a suitable activity such as Campaign, Raft Race, Endless River, or Daily River.
steps.tip: Campaign is the most forgiving place to learn the basic flow.

steps.title: Board and Control the Raft
steps.description: Get onto the raft and use the movement controls to help guide it along the river.
steps.tip: Make small, deliberate adjustments instead of constant direction changes.

steps.title: React to River Obstacles
steps.description: Watch the route ahead and adjust the raft's direction as the river becomes harder to navigate.
steps.tip: Look ahead before each turn so the raft has time to respond.

steps.title: Coordinate with Teammates
steps.description: Communicate about movement, upcoming obstacles, and when the group should change direction.
steps.tip: One agreed direction beats several players steering separately.

steps.title: Complete the Run
steps.description: Continue through the river until the activity is completed, then review the result and try a more challenging mode.
steps.tip: Use your first completed run to spot the turns that caused the most trouble.

fartWithYourFriendsGameModes.title: Fart With Your Friends Game Modes
fartWithYourFriendsGameModes.subtitle: Compare Campaign, Raft Race, Endless River, and Daily River at a glance.
fartWithYourFriendsGameModes.intro: Each mode offers a different way to play the river. Campaign provides structured progression, Raft Race focuses on direct competition, Endless River rewards pure survival, and Daily River refreshes the challenge every day.

modes.goal: Work through structured river challenges and learn the core gameplay.
modes.bestFor: New players who want steady progression and raft-control practice.

modes.goal: Race another team down the river and claim the finish first.
modes.bestFor: Competitive groups who want a direct team-versus-team challenge.

modes.goal: Keep navigating the river for as long as your team can hold on.
modes.bestFor: Practice runs and testing how long a crew can survive.

modes.goal: Take on the river's rotating daily challenge and aim for a strong finish.
modes.bestFor: Players who want a fresh recurring challenge with friends.

fartWithYourFriendsMultiplayerGuide.title: Fart With Your Friends Multiplayer Guide
fartWithYourFriendsMultiplayerGuide.subtitle: Set up a shared Roblox session, join the same server, and coordinate your raft team.
fartWithYourFriendsMultiplayerGuide.intro: Multiplayer runs work best when every player joins the same experience and agrees on a plan before the raft moves. Raft Race supports team formats from 1v1 through 4v4, so clear callouts matter in competitive lobbies.

steps.title: Add or Select Your Friends
steps.description: Make sure the players you want to invite are available on Roblox before starting the game session.
steps.tip: Decide who joins which team before entering a competitive match.

steps.title: Join the Same Game
steps.description: Open Fart With Your Friends and use Roblox's party or join features so everyone enters the same experience.
steps.tip: Confirm every friend has loaded into the session before choosing a mode.

steps.title: Select a Multiplayer Activity
steps.description: Choose a cooperative river activity or enter Raft Race for a team-versus-team challenge.
steps.tip: Practice together first, then switch to Raft Race when the crew is ready.

steps.title: Form the Teams
steps.description: Organize players into the available Raft Race formats, from 1v1 to 4v4.
steps.tip: Keep team sizes even when possible so the race stays balanced.

steps.title: Agree on Raft Commands
steps.description: Choose one player or a small group to call out turns, obstacle responses, and direction changes.
steps.tip: Short callouts such as left, right, slow, or turn keep reactions quick.

steps.title: Run the Challenge Together
steps.description: Coordinate raft movement, watch the river ahead, and adjust the plan when obstacles or difficult sections appear.
steps.tip: A shared direction beats every player acting independently.

faq.title: Fart With Your Friends
faq.subtitle: Quick answers about the game, its modes, and this wiki.

questions.question: What is Fart With Your Friends?
questions.answer: Fart With Your Friends is a chaotic Roblox raft game by HSF Studios where you guide an inflatable raft down wild rivers, dodge obstacles, and compete in funny multiplayer challenges across Campaign, Raft Race, Endless River, and Daily River modes.

questions.question: Is Fart With Your Friends free to play?
questions.answer: Yes. Fart With Your Friends is free to play on Roblox — open the official game page, hit play, and you are on the river in seconds.

questions.question: How many players can race together in Fart With Your Friends?
questions.answer: Raft Race supports team formats from 1v1 up to 4v4, so you can duel a friend or bring a full crew of four per side.

questions.question: Which animals can you unlock in Fart With Your Friends?
questions.answer: The current roster includes the Penguin, Fox, and Cat companions, and HSF Studios keeps adding more animals through updates and events.

questions.question: Does Fart With Your Friends have codes?
questions.answer: The Codes section on this site tracks every Fart With Your Friends code — when a new code drops, it appears here with its rewards and expiry window, alongside a step-by-step redemption guide.

questions.question: What is in the Fart With Your Friends Halloween Event?
questions.answer: The Halloween Event adds the Haunted Graveyard location, the Fart Phantom character, and a limited-time Halloween Bundle — the event module above covers every detail.
